title: Wi-Fi HaLow Bridges Smart Building Connectivity Gaps
summary: Wi-Fi HaLow helps bridge the gap between bandwidth, long range, and low power as edge AI transforms smart buildings.

title: InnovMetric Partners with Wuhan VISION3D
summary: InnovMetric has partnered with Wuhan VISION3D to combine automated 3D measurement hardware with PolyWorks inspection software.

title: FDA Panel Backs Multi-Cancer Blood Test
summary: An FDA advisory panel narrowly voted in favor of a multi-cancer blood test despite concerns regarding its effectiveness and life-saving proof.

title: Comparing 2nm Yields Across Major Foundries
summary: Estimated comparative yield counts on 2nm wafers show TSMC leading at 90%, followed by Intel at 85% and Samsung at 70%.

title: New Language-Processing Tool Estimates Suicide Risk from Text
summary: A new language-processing tool identifies high-risk individuals from natural language to enable swifter interventions.

title: Renault 8 Gordini Concept Reimagined as Electric Coupe
summary: Renault revealed a two-seat electric coupe concept with 270 horsepower based on its 1964 rally icon.

title: Forj Medical Opens New Manufacturing Facility in Costa Rica
summary: The medical device CDMO opened a 5,000-square-meter facility in Costa Rica to expand its production capacity.

title: Delos Data Introduces Apollo Chiplet for Heterogeneous AI
summary: Delos Data unveiled the Apollo chiplet to bridge endpoint semantics and interconnects across GPUs, CPUs, and memory.

title: TrackEverything 3D Tracker Handles Long-Horizon Video
summary: Researchers introduced TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker capable of tracking visible points across videos exceeding 1,000 frames.

title: Underwater C3-JEPA World Model for ROV Salvage
summary: Researchers introduced Underwater C3-JEPA, an object-centric cross-view world model that predicts task-object state evolution for heavy-load underwater ROV salvage.

title: DOE Allocates $99M for Geothermal Projects
summary: The U.S. Department of Energy announced over $99 million for 21 geothermal energy projects to advance technology and exploration.

title: Track-Conditioned Residual Estimation for FMCW Radar
summary: A proposed track-conditioned residual estimation method reduces radar data representation requirements while improving range and velocity accuracy in simulations.

title: Movable-Element STARS for Robust RSMA-SWIPT Systems
summary: A robust multiuser framework integrates movable-element STARS with RSMA and SWIPT to improve spatial flexibility and manage system imperfections.

title: Capability-Tradeoff Contact Selection for Legged Robots
summary: A new contact selection method balances physical support and mobility capabilities to speed up loco-manipulation planning for quadruped robots.

title: Riemannian MeanFlow Policy for Fast Visuomotor Learning
summary: The Riemannian MeanFlow Policy enables fast, on-manifold action sequence generation for robotic manipulation tasks with minimal network function evaluations.

title: Real-Time Force Regulation for Whole-Hand Dexterous Grasping
summary: A new framework estimates whole-hand contacts and dynamically recomputes force distributions to maintain and recover dexterous grasps under disturbances.

title: Rate-Distortion Optimization for Image Quality Metrics via Hessian Estimates
summary: Researchers propose approximating full-reference image quality metrics by an input-dependent quadratic distortion to enable block-wise computation in video codecs, achieving significant bit-rate savings.

title: Adversarial Robustness Evaluated in Low-Precision EEG Decoders
summary: An adversarial evaluation of compressed brain-computer interface decoders shows that accuracy-preserving compression techniques do not improve direct model robustness.

title: Body-Grounded Replanning for Physically Adaptive Robot Manipulation
summary: A novel framework uses internal physical states and language models to trigger high-level replanning, reducing physical effort and adapting manipulation strategies during execution.

title: Human-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: A new framework combines a frozen imitation policy with human-guided residual reinforcement learning to accelerate and stabilize online training for contact-rich manipulation tasks.

title: Lab on a Contact Lens Measures Stress Through Serotonin
summary: Scientists developed a smart contact lens that noninvasively measures low concentrations of serotonin in tears to offer a wearable method for tracking biochemical stress.

title: Accelerating Branch MPC with Parallel Direct Solvers on GPUs
summary: A GPU-accelerated direct linear solver exploits two levels of parallelism to significantly speed up branch model predictive control formulations.

title: MIT Handheld Device Collects Cells for Cancer Testing
summary: MIT researchers developed a handheld system that gently collects living cells from patient samples to aid cancer testing.

title: Blue Energy Files Permit for Texas Gas-to-Nuclear Project
summary: Blue Energy has filed the first portion of its NRC construction permit application for a gas-to-nuclear power plant in Texas.

title: Bechtel Exits TerraPower Natrium Project
summary: Bechtel is exiting TerraPower's Natrium project in Wyoming, requiring a rebid of the engineering, procurement, and construction contract.

title: Time Crystals Synchronize Across Microscopic Distances
summary: Researchers demonstrated that multiple time crystals inside a semiconductor can synchronize their oscillations using spin-polarized electrons.

title: Startup Tests Offshore Geothermal Power System Near Oregon
summary: Endurance Energy drilled a seafloor well off the Oregon coast to test an underwater geothermal power generator.

title: Cognex Launches In-Sight 1750 Wafer ID System
summary: Cognex launched a new wafer identification system that uses AI, imaging, and illumination to read difficult markings.

title: EOS Partners with Axiomatek for Mexico Distribution
summary: EOS named Axiomatek as its Mexico distribution partner to expand local access to polymer and metal LPBF systems.

title: SHINING 3D Renews WorldSkills Partnership Through 2028
summary: SHINING 3D will support five skills competitions at WorldSkills Shanghai 2026 using its 3D scanning and metrology technologies.
